scripts.text:
[Kashin]
I am Kashin, distributor
of Kunai for Ninjas. Take
a look around and let me
know if you're interested
in any of my wares.
scripts.translation:
[卡辛]
我是卡辛，忍者的飞刀经销商。
请随意看看，如果有看中的商品，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Kashin]
Well then, thank you
for visiting my shop.
Please come to me when
you need to buy some
Kunais. Goodbye for now~
scripts.translation:
[卡辛]
那么，感谢光临我的店铺。
如果需要购买飞刀，请随时来找我。
再见~

scripts.text:
[Kashin]
I am Kashin, distributor
of Kunai for Ninjas. If you
have any friends that are
Ninjas, then you might
want to tell them about me.
scripts.translation:
[卡辛]
我是卡辛，忍者的飞刀经销商。
如果你有忍者朋友，不妨告诉他们我的名字。

scripts.text:
[Kashin]
You can exchange
{0} {1} and
{2} {3} for every
set of 10 {4}.

[Kashin]
I can only give you a maximum of 500 sets of Kunais at a time.
If you want to cancel the trade, then please enter ''0.'' How many
Kunai sets would you like?
scripts.translation:
[卡辛]
我一次最多只能提供500套飞刀。
如果想取消交易，请输入''0''。
请问您想要兑换多少套飞刀？

scripts.text:
[Kashin]
Eh? I'm sorry, but
I can't give you that
many Kunai sets. Please
enter a value less than 500.
scripts.translation:
[卡辛]
啊？抱歉，我无法提供那么多套飞刀。
请输入小于500的数值。

scripts.text:
[Kashin]
Hmm, you don't have
enough items for this
Kunai exchange. Please
check your items again.
scripts.translation:
[卡辛]
嗯，您的物品不足以进行这次飞刀兑换。
请再次检查您的物品。

scripts.text:
[Kashin]
Hmm, it seems like your
Inventory doesn't have
enough space to store
more items. You better
free up some space first.
scripts.translation:
[卡辛]
嗯，看来您的背包空间不足，无法存放更多物品。
请先腾出一些空间。

scripts.text:
[Kashin]
Great, everything is in
order, so let's go ahead
and complete this trade.
I'm sure that you'll be
quite satisfied with
these Kunais.
scripts.translation:
[卡辛]
很好，一切就绪，让我们完成这笔交易吧。
我相信您会对这些飞刀感到满意的。
